capabilities_done: (1) corner pin on 3D layers (7bfe109; STU-CMP-010 step 3 before step 5): the pinned content is the plane's texture; three_d::pinned_bounds normalises the pin and gives the pinned content rectangle, which the depth ranks, shading, shadows, defocus, aux channels and immersive frames read; an unlit plane resamples once through pin then plane homography (CPU and GPU). Refused typed: composition_3d_corner_pin_degenerate (denominator sign change over the content, non-finite, beyond 16384 px), composition_mask_path_with_corner_pin (as on 2D layers); Folio refuses folded / collinear quads at open.

(2) clipping on 3D layers (7bfe109; Folio clipped, clip-to-base reading of pigment MaskFormat::BaseAlpha): a clipped 3D layer, or a 2D layer clipped to a 3D base (or above 3D depth pieces), takes the base's alpha drawn alone (3D base projected through the active camera; masks, pin and track matte kept; opacity and fill 1) as a screen-space matte under every depth piece; skipped base drops the clipped layer; refused as on 2D: composition_clipped_matte, composition_clip_without_base, composition_clip_base_adjustment; a collapsed 3D precomp as base: composition_3d_layer_option.

(3) collapsed 3D precompositions (7bfe109; STU-CMP-016 'inner 3D layers can interact with outer 3D space'): nested visible content layers join the OUTER run (chain = nested chain, then the precomp layer's own 3D transform, its parent chain); 2D nested layers lie in the precomp plane (Material::TWO_D, unlit); outer camera/lights; nested cameras ignored; recursion bounded (MAX_PRECOMP_DEPTH); three_d_planes_at gives nested planes the precomp layer's object id. Refused composition_3d_collapse_nested_layer (nested light, track matte, matte source, clipped, adjustment, unlinked mask), composition_collapse_blend_mode / composition_collapse_matte on the precomp layer.

(4) anti-aliased aux channels (dc4b5bf; STU-CMP-050): three_d::coverage::pixel_coverage = n x n box ranking filter with non-refractive transparency (front to back, a x transmittance; empty samples count); aux_channels_aa: exact objectId (largest merged coverage; ties nearer, then lower id), idCoverage, coverage, dominant object's coverage-weighted depth, coverage-weighted normals; id_matte_aa; EXR incl. idCoverage; composition::three_d_aux_channels_aa, CompositionTemporalSource::three_d_aux_channels_aa. Refused before per-pixel work: NaN/inf transform or camera (InvalidState three_d_transform), NaN alpha, samples outside 1..=16, > 2^28 pixel x plane x sample tests.

(5) Cryptomatte (1042418; STU-CMP-050; Psyop spec v1.2.0): murmur3_32 (MurmurHash3_x86_32 seed 0), hash_to_float (exponent 0/255 toggle bit 23), type_key (first 7 hex of the type name hash), build() from the ranking filter (merge by id, rank by coverage, even levels 2..=16, default 6), channels {type}NN.R/G/B/A, metadata cryptomatte/<key>/name|hash|conversion|manifest (JSON, escaped), exr::encode_exr_f32_with_attributes (string attributes, bounded), to_exr for several types, matte(names) and matte_from_ranks (bit-exact id match); composition::three_d_cryptomatte; adapter three_d_cryptomatte (CryptoObject = layer ids, CryptoMaterial = Material::name of the evaluated material options) and three_d_cryptomatte_names. aux_capability('cryptomatte') now Ok. Refused composition_3d_cryptomatte_parameter: bad type names/levels, > 65536 names, names > 4096 bytes, manifest > 16 MiB, unnamed planes, NaN coverage.

(6) motion blur of 3D layers (18f3ab4; STU-MOT-004 shutter_angle/phase/samples_per_frame 'Motion-blur samples for 3D layers', STU-MOT-005 per-layer switch; Folio StudioCompositionMotionSettings): CompositionTemporalSource::with_motion_blur; samples at t + tpf (phase + angle (k + 0.5)/n)/360; listed 3D planes (and the camera when listed) evaluated per sample, others/lights/materials at t; the run becomes one layer of SceneContent::Accumulated (composition::AccumulatedContent; every sample rendered by the context's backend, premultiplied mean, bounded 64 samples, surfaces charged before allocation). Refused: composition_motion_blur_parameters, composition_motion_blur_layer (2D, light, collapsed precomp listed), composition_motion_blur_blend_mode, unknown composition/layer (DanglingInput). Depth of field on 3D cameras already existed (SMB-AE-3D slice 3).
